manual_browser_checks: Clicked Open device in Home Assistant; fixture recorded /config/devices/device/synthetic-iphone.
Expanded the ten phone entities and clicked Activity; the canonical entity opened in Sources. Back to issue returned to the same phone issue.
Escape dismissed the dialog and returned to the queue.
Standalone Outdoor reading remains visible with its condition before disclosures; missing metadata shows Source details unavailable without a fabricated link.

visual_review.independent_review: Read-only reviewer checked the implementation and initial phone screenshot; identified hidden standalone identity. Corrected before final screenshots.
corrections: Keep standalone source names and conditions visible.
Remove stacked spacing while preserving separate device and pause controls.

validation.detector: Impeccable detect reported three existing shared-style warnings: a side-tab border accent and two rounded elements with border accents. These existing banner/navigation patterns were outside this dialog change and were left unchanged.
